UnitStatement: The co-development ruling run is labeled ORCHESTRATOR_CODEV_RULING.
The ruling records a human governance decision for the only blocker-subset cycle identified in the dependency graph dossier package.
The human ruling record is dated 2026-05-24.
The ruling source is a human instruction issued in an ORCHESTRATOR session.
DEL-03-01 and DEL-04-01 are allowed to proceed together as a co-development cluster.
ORCHESTRATOR will report that project-wide blocker computation remains unavailable until the follow-up dependency closure scan passes.
The ruling does not retire, rewrite, reverse, or reclassify any Dependencies.csv row.
The DEL-03-01 / DEL-04-01 blocker-subset cycle remains known and accepted for the first development tranche.
WORKING_ITEMS may work the two deliverables iteratively as a paired tranche instead of requiring one to fully precede the other.

The expected closure mechanism is development evidence (contracts, probes, stubs, fixtures, or decisions) that lets relevant dependency rows be marked satisfied, waived, not applicable, retired, or otherwise changed by a later approved workflow.
Until a follow-up closure scan passes, ORCHESTRATOR must not compute or report project-wide BLOCKED/UNBLOCKED under strict FULL_GRAPH semantics.
ORCHESTRATOR may report lifecycle state and may report the accepted co-development cluster as a known blocker-computation exception.
